**The problem you are trying to solve** — not the feature, the situation. What did you lose track of,
or have to do by hand?

**What you would expect to happen instead**

**Would it need a new dependency, or a new permission?**

> Worth knowing before you write this up: JobSeeker has zero dependencies and asks for the minimum
> macOS permissions on purpose, and it will never apply or send anything without explicit approval.
> Proposals that change those properties are unlikely to be accepted, however useful — see
> [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).
